criteria.title: Status events cannot satisfy terminal command completion
criteria.assertion: Public command helpers must subscribe to terminal result kinds for completion and keep status kinds as progress-only side channels.
criteria.expected_result: LLM deploy and rollback browser helpers await only kind 7973 terminal results; DNS status kind 6941 remains separate from 794x terminal results.

criteria.title: Request/result correlation is required
criteria.assertion: Public, DNS, encrypted, and operator result waits must ignore or reject replies that do not correlate to the built request event id and requester.
criteria.expected_result: Filters include request correlation tags, duplicate events are idempotent, and encrypted results require decrypted request_event_id to match.

criteria.title: Publish OK and zero-accepted outcomes are explicit
criteria.assertion: Request publishers must require at least one accepted relay OK and surface zero accepted relays as pre-acceptance failure.
criteria.expected_result: Public, encrypted, operator, and backend command publishers reject zero accepted publishes and preserve accepted/rejected OK metadata where returned.

criteria.title: CLOSED and AUTH failures are explicit
criteria.assertion: Result subscriptions must fail distinctly for auth-related closure and all-known-relay closure before terminal result.
criteria.expected_result: Public and encrypted browser waits report AUTH separately from all-relay CLOSED; operator waits surface post-acceptance subscription closure.

criteria.title: Abort and timeout semantics are explicit and deterministic
criteria.assertion: Abort signals and configured timeouts cancel result waits and clean up subscriptions without being treated as terminal success or backend failure proof.
criteria.expected_result: Public awaitResult rejects explicit aborts; encrypted waits reject configured timeout; operator context cancellation is post-acceptance abort when publish already succeeded.
